_provenance.derived_from: Cambridge published mark schemes for 0460, Papers 11-13, 21-23 and 41-43, March 2020 to November 2025
_provenance.derivation_policy: structure only. No mark-scheme wording is reproduced in learner-facing output.
_provenance.validation: 125 of 126 papers’ part tariffs sum exactly to the paper total (150 for Paper 1, whose six questions are printed and three answered; 60 for Papers 2 and 4). Where a scheme’s parse fell short and the question paper’s summed exactly, the question paper’s parts and tariffs are used.

paper_architecture.P1: 1 hour 45 minutes; six 25-mark questions in three sections (one per theme), three answered. Every question has the same tariff pattern: 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 5 and a 7-mark case-study part, levels-marked.
paper_architecture.P2: 1 hour 30 minutes, 60 marks, all questions answered; the first question is mapwork on a 1:25 000 or 1:50 000 map with a key (one third of the marks); the rest use graphs, tables, photographs and diagrams. No place-specific knowledge needed.
paper_architecture.P4: 1 hour 30 minutes, 60 marks, two compulsory questions set on a fieldwork enquiry: method, results, presentation, analysis, conclusion and evaluation.

case_study_part.structure: Level 1 (1-3 marks): simple statements. Level 2 (4-6): developed or linked statements and a named example, capped at 5 without one. Level 3 (7): comprehensive, accurate statements with a named example and place-specific detail.
